name: Pear
selection: Check the neck — press near the stem with a thumb. If it gives, it is ripe. The body stays firm long after the flesh inside is ready.
storage: Ripen on the counter, then refrigerate. Pears ripen from the inside out and are picked deliberately unripe.

varieties.name: Bartlett
varieties.note: Turns yellow as it ripens — the only common pear that signals readiness by color.

varieties.name: Bosc
varieties.note: Firm and dense with a long neck. Holds its shape when cooked.

varieties.name: Anjou
varieties.note: Stays green when ripe. Judge by the neck, never by color.
